title: Rename gateway.go → gateway_core.go
description:
## What
After extracting gateway_helpers.go, gateway_stream.go, and gateway_handlers.go, the remaining gateway.go contains only "core" code. Rename it to `gateway_core.go`.

## What should remain (~1100 lines)
- `server` struct (orig lines 100-133)
- `(s *server).Close` (orig lines 137-141)
- `Run` func (orig lines 474-476)
- `RunWithAuth` func (orig lines 480-676)
- `startHTTPServer` func (orig lines 873-1103) — route registration
- Rate limiter types & constructor: `rateBucket`, `keyedRateLimiter`, `newKeyedRateLimiter`, `newKeyedRateLimiterFromEnv`, `(rl *keyedRateLimiter).Allow`, `apiLimiter` var (orig lines 177-260)
- CORS middleware: `corsMiddleware`, `isAllowedOrigin`, `allowedOriginsFromEnv`, `requestHostname` (orig lines 2460-2559)
- Rate limit middleware: `rateLimitMiddleware`, `rateLimitKey`, `clientIP` (orig lines 2670-2709)
- Auth middleware: `apiKeyMiddleware`, `tenantMiddleware` (orig lines 2712-2763)
- gRPC interceptor: `apiKeyUnaryInterceptor` (orig lines 2603-2615)
- Env/config helpers: `addrFromEnv`, `dialSafetyKernel`, `safetyTransportCredentials` (orig lines 2617-2668)
- Metrics: `statusRecorder` struct + methods, `(s *server).instrumented` (orig lines 3145-3204)
- Remaining constants: `defaultGrpcAddr`, `defaultHttpAddr`, `defaultMetricsAddr`, `defaultArtifactMaxBytes`, `defaultRateLimitRPS`, `defaultRateLimitBurst`, `defaultMaxHeaderBytes`, `shutdownTimeout`, env constants
- Import block (trim to only what's needed)

## How
1. `git mv core/controlplane/gateway/gateway.go core/controlplane/gateway/gateway_core.go`
2. Clean up the import block — remove imports that are no longer used in this file
3. Run `go build ./cmd/cordum-api-gateway`

## Notes
- Use `git mv` to preserve history
- The import block will likely have many unused imports after the extractions — `go build` will tell you which to remove
definitionOfDone: gateway_core.go exists with the core server code
Import block is clean (no unused imports)
